answer.reason: The verses give Sherebiah a few distinct events: being brought to Ezra, being set apart to guard the offering, helping the people understand the law, and leading the Levites in worship.

clauses.english: was brought to Ezra as a man of understanding to serve at the house of God
clauses.quote: they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli

clauses.english: was set apart as one of twelve chief priests to receive the silver, gold and vessels
clauses.quote: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah

clauses.english: helped cause the people to understand the law as it was read
clauses.quote: caused the people to understand the law

clauses.english: stood on the stairs of the Levites and cried to the LORD, then called the people to bless him
clauses.quote: cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God

doubts: EZR 8:24 calls the twelve chief of the priests, though Sherebiah is elsewhere a Levite; kept as the verse words it.
NEH 10:12, NEH 12:8 and NEH 12:24 only list his name and were left out.
